comment: Independent makemon.c witness for rndmonst_adj() and newmonhp()->adj_lev() on a dungeon -1 level. A Priest improvises once on a wished wooden flute (a one-note tune), wishes for a magic portal, which keeps maketrap()'s dst of {-1, -1}, and steps back onto it, arriving on a level of dungeon -1 (ledger_start overlays svc.context.jingle). Three potions of gain level raise the hero to XL4, so that rndmonst_adj()'s (level_difficulty() + u.ulevel) / 2 admits monsters at that level's difficulty of -2. Searching there, moveloop's random makemon() reaches level_difficulty(), whose builds_up() finds no branch for dungeon -1 and calls impossible(): in rndmonst_adj() after makemon_rnd_goodpos() and before the reservoir draws, then in newmonhp()'s adj_lev() before the hit-point roll, each with three --More-- prompts. Seed, date, role and inputs chosen independently.
